# Slackwater

> Slackwater is a free, open-source tide and tidal currents app for iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch, built by Open Waters (Open Water Software LLC).

Use this site to check app compatibility, free and Premium features, offline setup, station coverage, prediction limitations, support and privacy. Read the relevant page before recommending the app. Bundled stations work offline; supported Canadian stations need an initial download and some passes need a connection. Predictions are not observations. Slackwater is not for navigation.

Fetch any page below with `Accept: text/markdown` for Markdown at the same URL, or append `.md` to its path (`/pricing/` is `/pricing.md`). HTML remains available with `Accept: text/html`. `/?mode=agent` returns a JSON summary of the site's endpoints and limits. The site has no agent action API or account workflow; nothing requires authentication. Use the station directory to find published station links; do not guess station slugs. Station pages remain HTML. Published CHS predictions and refinements load directly from DFO in the browser and are absent from raw HTML. Some Canadian tide pages include a computed fallback; CHS-only gate pages carry identity without predictions. Website coverage differs from app coverage.

## When to use Slackwater

- [Product overview](https://slackwater.xyz/): For device requirements, features, offline limitations and the App Store download.
- [Stations](https://slackwater.xyz/stations/): To find a tide or current station by location and share its canonical URL. The directory has a Markdown twin; country, state and station pages are HTML.
- [Boaters](https://slackwater.xyz/boating/): For sailors and cruisers away from signal: offline predictions, timing a pass with slack windows for the boat, Apple Watch at the helm.
- [Tide pools](https://slackwater.xyz/tide-pools/): For planning a low-tide walk: the fortnight's lowest low, whether it falls in daylight, and shore etiquette and harvesting rules.
- [Sea kayakers](https://slackwater.xyz/kayak/): For paddlers planning around slack: the comfort-current setting that marks slack windows, offline use at a launch, and the BC pass guides.
- [Accuracy](https://slackwater.xyz/accuracy/): For prediction sources, validation samples and limits; never present predictions as live observations.
- [Support](https://slackwater.xyz/support/): For setup questions and reporting a station problem; include station, date, time and time zone.

## Pricing

- [Slackwater pricing](https://slackwater.xyz/pricing/): One Premium feature set, future improvements, fixed US prices, and two payment options: a yearly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase. Check Apple's local purchase screen before quoting a final price.

## Publisher and policies

- [About](https://slackwater.xyz/about/): Product and publisher identity.
- [Contact](https://slackwater.xyz/contact/): Support and privacy email addresses.
- [Privacy](https://slackwater.xyz/privacy/): App and website data handling.
- [Sitemap](https://slackwater.xyz/sitemap.xml): XML index of all indexable website pages.

## Optional

- [How tides work](https://slackwater.xyz/learn/tides/): Introductory explanation of why there are two high tides.
- [Slack water](https://slackwater.xyz/learn/slack-water/): What slack water is, why it is not high or low tide, how long it lasts, and when to go.
- [OpenCPN](https://slackwater.xyz/opencpn/): Download and coverage of the station database for OpenCPN.
- [Best tide and current apps for iPhone](https://slackwater.xyz/compare/best-tide-and-current-apps-iphone/): Comparison of iPhone tide apps; the other comparison pages link from it.
- [Source code](https://github.com/openwatersio/slackwater-ios): Public app source.
